The web rendering slice is now substantially complete, but overall parity remains at **11.7%** and W1 is still in progress.

What is verified:

- Production web at 390×844 renders Markdown, math, syntax-highlighted code, six Mermaid SVGs, and every canonical OpenUI fixture node.
- Answers, plan state, notes, and artifact saves survive reload with validated receipts.
- Artifact, media, image, and handoff actions now use canonical OpenUI actions.
- Ephemeral documents remain mount-local; resumable/workspace documents persist.
- Repeated declared IDs are scoped by message and fence position.
- No horizontal overflow at phone width.
- 848 web tests pass with 10,607 assertions.
- Strict TypeScript and Vite/Nitro production build pass.
- Independent Terra-high and Terra-low reviews found no regressions in the final fixes.

The build and `/goal` evidence are recorded in:

- [Cross-platform build specification](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/plans/cross-platform-parity-build.md)
- [Execution program and goal pseudocode](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/plans/cross-platform-parity-execution.md)
- [Current evidence baseline](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/plans/cross-platform-parity-baseline.md)

W1 remains open because:

- Browser-source OpenUI still uses the legacy renderer; grouped questions, aggregate quizzes/decks, lifecycle retention, matching identity, and legacy-state migration are not lossless yet.
- Completed UI receipts are not atomically linked to durable tutor-turn delivery.
- Canonical actions update rendered state but do not yet materialize all learner records used by Usage, SRS, goals, and study tracking.
- Chat document identity still needs stable session/fork scope.
- Mobile and TUI have not passed the complete rendered fixture/action/restart matrix.

ADB currently reports no attached device, so this was production browser acceptance at phone dimensions—not physical Android proof. Luna is unavailable in the callable roster and no `luna` executable is installed, so the required Luna review remains explicitly pending. `vet` also remains unverified because it fails while reconstructing the repository’s aggregate dirty diff with `DiffApplicationError`.

Implemented the rich-rendering and OpenUI tranche across web, desktop, and mobile.

- Mobile now renders bounded GFM Markdown, copyable code, KaTeX MathML, and all 12 web-supported Mermaid grammars through [LocalRich.dom.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/LocalRich.dom.tsx).
- Canonical JSON and browser-source OpenUI now compile to the same semantic document using a bounded, non-evaluating [shared compiler](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/packages/learner-contracts/src/openui-source.ts).
- Split streaming chunks cannot expose OpenUI source or double-render the resulting document.
- Partial, malformed, unsafe, or future OpenUI source is displayed as escaped inert text.
- Web’s script-capable legacy fallback was removed. Rejected animation HTML cannot mount an iframe or execute scripts.
- NodePod was regenerated, and desktop’s embedded Nitro/web renderer was rebuilt.

Verification:

- Shared contracts: 45/45 tests, 350 assertions.
- Mobile: 315/315 tests, 1,296 assertions; strict typecheck and Android export pass.
- Web: 874/874 tests, 10,749 assertions; strict typecheck and production Vite/Nitro build pass.
- Desktop: 12/12 runtime tests, strict typecheck, source-matched Electron/Nitro staging pass.
- Clean Android release: [app-release.apk](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk), 121,281,227 bytes, SHA-256 `30c1c92b5c5e1bcb6254c09f030bcdeb97a539fbac06271216991fb71ad8228b`.
- APK inspection confirms exactly one current DOM JS entry and one HTML entry, with no stale CSS/webfont bundles.

Still unaccepted:

- ADB currently reports no attached device, so physical Markdown/math/Mermaid/OpenUI pixels and interactions remain unverified.
- OpenTUI presents every canonical node with truthful Mermaid/media handoffs, but keyboard actions, filesystem journal wiring, Pi transport, and real-PTY acceptance remain.
- Structured citations, native video/animation, and authenticated code-execution handoffs remain mobile gaps.
- Luna was unavailable; its independent review remains pending. Vet also remains unverified because it fails reconstructing the pre-existing dirty aggregate diff.
